families.name: OLTC, oil arc
families.blurb: On-load tap changer. The arc breaks in transformer oil. Classic in-tank types.

families.name: OLTC, vacuum
families.blurb: On-load tap changer. The arc breaks in a vacuum interrupter. Less oil carbon, longer contact life.

families.name: OLTC, air / dry
families.blurb: On-load tap changer for dry-type or air-insulated transformers.

families.name: OLTC, gas
families.blurb: On-load tap changer for SF6 / gas-insulated transformers.

families.name: OLTC, reactive / compartment
families.blurb: Compartment or reactor-type on-load tap changer, including North America styles.

families.name: Step voltage regulator
families.blurb: Tap changer built for a step-voltage regulator, not a power-transformer in-tank OLTC.

families.name: OCTC / DETC
families.blurb: De-energized tap changer. Change taps only with the transformer off.

families.name: Motor drive / MDU
families.blurb: The motor cabinet that turns the tap changer. HWV already includes a drive on the commercial list — do not add CMA7 twice.

families.name: Other
families.blurb: Listed on the live shop. Page + PDF only when we have real copy.

types.name: CM
types.oneLiner: Classic in-tank OLTC: diverter switch plus tap selector. Arc in oil.
types.fromLive: Type CM is a classic on-load tap changer composed by a diverter switch & tap selector.
ratings: III / II 500 A and 600 A; I also 800 / 1200 / 1500 A
Um 72.5 / 126 / 170 / 252 kV; selector B / C / D / DE

types.name: CMD
types.oneLiner: Larger oil OLTC, same family idea as CM, higher current steps.
types.fromLive: Type CMD is designed with state-of-the-art technology and concept.
ratings: Um 72.5 / 126 / 170 / 252 kV; selector B / C / D / DE

types.name: CV
types.oneLiner: Selector-switch oil OLTC. The oil ancestor of CV2.
types.fromLive: Type CV is a typical selector switch structure tap changer.
ratings: III 350 A; I also 700 A as CVI 700
Um 40.5 / 72.5 kV only (live “110 kV” is not a CV Um)

types.name: SV
types.oneLiner: Oil compound selector switch, 500 A. Not a CV2.
types.fromLive: Listed with CV in the CV & SV technical data.

types.name: CV2
types.oneLiner: Vacuum version of CV. Selector-switch OLTC for primarily-delta transformers up to 132 kV.
types.fromLive: Type CV2 is of selector switch structure, a vacuum version of type CV on-load tap changer. Mechanical backup contacts. Most economic solution for primarily-delta transformer up to 132kV system.
ratings: Vacuum selector switch; mechanical backup contacts; no grade letter
III 350 A and 600 A only — no CV2-500
Step voltage 2000 V (10 contacts) / 1500 V (12 contacts)

types.name: CM2
types.oneLiner: Vacuum version of CM. Diverter + selector, vacuum bottles.
types.fromLive: Type CM2 on-load tap changer perfectly integrates the proven reliability of type CM and vacuum switching technology.
ratings: III / II 500 A and 600 A only — no CM2 III 800 / 1000
Um 72.5 / 126 / 170 / 252 kV; selector B / C / D / DE

types.name: SHZV
types.oneLiner: Vacuum version of CMD. Higher current than CM2 when CM2 does not cover Iᵤ.
types.fromLive: Type SHZV is a vacuum version of type CMD on-load tap changer.
ratings: Selector B / C / D / DE; max. step voltage 4000 V

types.name: SHZVG
types.oneLiner: Larger vacuum OLTC after SHZV max current (1300 / 1500 A III).
types.fromLive: Listed on the live shop as SHZVG.
ratings: Vacuum combined; after SHZV max current
Selector B / C / D / DE / E; max. step voltage 6000 V

types.name: CHVT
types.oneLiner: High-voltage vacuum OLTC for HVDC / converter transformers. Longdong ±800 kV, May 2025.
types.fromLive: CHVT is a high-voltage, big capacity vacuum OLTC, jointly developed by Huaming and EPRI of China State Grid specially for HVDC. Live page: maximum 6000 V step voltage and 1500 A rated current for three phases.
ratings: Live shop: 1500 A three-phase, 6000 V step
types.note: Live shop has no CHVT technical PDF as of 2026-08-19. The 1500 A / 6000 V step figures are from the Joomla page, not a brochure.

types.name: HWV
types.oneLiner: On-tank / external vacuum OLTC. Commercial type already includes the motor drive.
types.fromLive: Listed under vacuum / on-tank types.
ratings: On-tank vacuum; oil chamber separate from the main tank
MDU is on the chamber — do not add CMA7 twice
Um 17.5 / 40.5 / 72.5 kV; no selector grade letter

types.name: HWDK
types.oneLiner: Reactive-transition compartment OLTC, used mostly in North America, usually on the secondary.
types.fromLive: HWDK is a reactive transition compartment type on-load tap changer, mostly used in North America market. Usually installed on the secondary side. Maximum current 2000 A. Highest equipment voltage 72.6 kV. Standard position 33.
ratings: Live shop: Um up to 72.6 kV

types.name: CVT
types.oneLiner: Vacuum OLTC for dry-type / air-insulated transformers. Low Um.
types.fromLive: Dry type family on the live shop.
ratings: Brochure table: 160 A (200 A is not in that table)
Max. step voltage 500 V; linear; max. 9 positions

types.name: CZ
types.oneLiner: Vacuum dry / air OLTC at distribution voltages.
types.fromLive: Dry type family on the live shop.
ratings: Single-phase air-insulated vacuum; three units, one MDU
Brochure: 500 A (CZ 600 not in this brochure)
Max. step voltage 950 V; max. 17 positions

types.name: SHGV
types.oneLiner: Combined vacuum OLTC for SF6 / gas-insulated regulating transformers.
types.fromLive: SHGV vacuum OLTC is of combined structure for SF6 gas insulation regulating transformers. Diverter switch in a separate gas compartment. Neutral point of star, or single-phase.

types.name: HMDK
types.oneLiner: Reactance-transition tap changer for a distribution step-voltage regulator.
types.fromLive: HMDK is a classic product used on step voltage regulators of distribution networks. Maximum current 640 A. Highest impulse level 200 kV. Reactance transition. Standard 33 positions.

types.name: WSL / WDL
types.oneLiner: Cage-type de-energized tap changer. Transformer must be off.
types.fromLive: Live slug W_L. Cage type.

types.name: WDG
types.oneLiner: Drum-type de-energized tap changer.
types.fromLive: Live slug W_G. Drum type.

types.name: ZWC
types.oneLiner: Linear de-energized tap changer.
types.fromLive: Linear type on the live shop.

types.name: SHM-D
types.oneLiner: Motor drive unit for in-tank OLTCs.
types.fromLive: Motor drive unit on the live shop.

types.name: CMA7
types.oneLiner: Motor drive unit. Not required a second time on HWV.
types.fromLive: Motor drive unit on the live shop.

types.name: SHM-X
types.oneLiner: Motor drive unit. Live shop body repeats the SHM-D paragraph — ignore that paste.
types.fromLive: Heading is SHM-X. Body text on the live page is a copy of SHM-D.

types.name: SHM-KX
types.oneLiner: Controller / drive cabinet. Type-test pack on file for SHM-XE.
types.fromLive: Controller on the live shop.

types.name: HMJK-II
types.oneLiner: Online monitoring device for the tap changer.
types.fromLive: Monitoring on the live shop.

types.name: ZXJY
types.oneLiner: Online oil filter plant.
types.fromLive: Online oil filter on the live shop.

types.name: HMIET
types.oneLiner: Automatic voltage relay: AVR, parallel, line-drop compensation, T1/T2 delay.
types.fromLive: HMIET is an intelligent automatic voltage relay.

types.name: ET-SZ6
types.oneLiner: Digital voltage relay: AVR, over-current / over-voltage block, parallel, delay.
types.fromLive: ET-SZ6 is a classic digital voltage relay.

types.name: HMC-3C
types.oneLiner: Position indicator for CMA7 / CMA9 motor drives. Decimal in, BCD out.
types.fromLive: HMC-3C displays tap position and has 1-N / stop / N-1 plus remote-control lamp.
